---
title: "Article Explorer"
---

```{python}
#| output: false
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import itables
from dash_helpers import load

studies = load("studies.csv")

table = (
    studies[
        [
            "title",
            "journal",
            "publication_year",
            "specialty_label",
            "workflow_stage_label",
            "device_label",
            "image_modalities_label",
            "study_summary",
        ]
    ]
    .rename(
        columns={
            "title": "Title",
            "journal": "Journal",
            "publication_year": "Year",
            "specialty_label": "Specialty",
            "workflow_stage_label": "Workflow Stage",
            "device_label": "Device",
            "image_modalities_label": "Image Modalities",
            "study_summary": "Study Summary",
        }
    )
    .sort_values("Year", ascending=False)
)
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: "Browse, search and filter the 313 included studies"
itables.show(
    table,
    maxBytes=0,
    layout={"topStart": "search", "topEnd": "buttons"},
    buttons=["copyHtml5", "csvHtml5"],
    column_filters="header",
    lengthMenu=[10, 25, 50, 100],
    pageLength=25,
    scrollX=True,
    order=[[2, "desc"]],
    columnDefs=[
        {"targets": [0], "width": "24%"},
        {"targets": [7], "width": "30%"},
        {"targets": "_all", "className": "dt-left"},
    ],
    style="width:100%",
    classes="display cell-border",
    showIndex=False,
)
```
